description: People the user has written to before whose latest email came after the user's latest email to them, in the last two weeks: people outside the user's own company first, then coworkers, each longest wait first. Each has name, email, mailbox, when they last wrote, when the user last wrote, the days waited, and `coworker` when they work at the user's own company. Asked who to follow up with, lead with the people who are not coworkers.
name: mail_waiting_on_me
title: Mail waiting on you
